_doc: A light carried on the street map at night (systems/carriedLight.js; the map's half ui/innerMapTorchlight.js). TORCH: the good 'torch' (bound by hand: one stick-stuff from `bind.sticks` — n torches per unit — and one binder from `bind.binders`, resin, tallow or a strip of linen/cloth, all used up), lit from the packs (Light a Torch), burns `torch.hours` game hours and is gone (smoke: the sink); put out part-burnt, the stub is kept and lit first next time. A fresh one is lit from the packs when it gutters out, while you have any. LANTERN: the good 'lantern' (glassblowers, the chandler's stall), lasting; it burns fuel: one of `fuels` (lamp oil, candles, tallow: game hours a unit) filled in from the packs when you light it dry or when it runs dry, up to `lantern.capacity` hours in it. Either goes out in the water (a swim, a dive: a torch is lost) and when you leave the street map (a torch's stub kept). L on the street map (ui/innerMapNight.js) shutters the light: a carried light goes out. LIGHT: by night (the street's darkness over `minDarkness`, full at `fullDarkness`) a warm pool round you, `radius` px at zoom 1 grown with the dark (a torch flickers); carrying none you see only `bareNight` px into the dark (at full dark). FISH: held by deep water at night (the bank, or your rowboat) the fish within `fish.pull` tiles of the light gather slowly (`fish.speed` of their pace) in a ring `fish.ring` tiles about where it falls on the water (`fish.reach` tiles at most off the bank), up to `fish.extra` more come up from deeper (one shoal every `fish.comeEvery` s), their backs show brighter in it (`fish.glow`), and a line cast within `fish.near` tiles of you gets the light's `biteBonus` more chance of a bite, scaled by the dark: nothing by day. POACHERS: a poacher at your fish trap sees a light coming from `poach.scareMult` x the trap's scareReach (data/fishTraps.json); a lantern hung at a trap (Hang a Lantern at the Trap: the lantern and its fuel go with it, topped up with a unit from the packs if under `poach.minHang` hours) keeps any poacher off while it burns; taken down, the lantern and what fuel is left come back.
